primary: Chrome bookmarks permission + account-level tree mirror

platforms.full_sync_oracle: one permission grant mirrors the complete bookmark tree, folder path, relation time and stable bookmark ID without opening items one by one

platforms.canary: connect Chrome bookmarks, import an entire deterministic fixture tree, show every row in the platform-grouped table, then add/remove one fixture bookmark and reconcile incrementally
completion_proof: Chrome bookmarks API getTree returned successfully
final relation marker emitted after every chunk

global_degradation_contract: Every source has independent policy/auth/technical gates, pause/resume/cancel/retry, checkpoints and a circuit breaker. A partial or failed source never infers deletion and never makes other sources unavailable.
runtime_truth_boundary: Fixture and deterministic tests prove contracts only. Real-account completeness remains NOT_RUN until Build Agent produces provider/browser canary evidence.
